evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.
